method: Started from the 61 kind=='town' gazetteer entries. Excluded the brief's underground/indoor list and resolved doubtful entries from the newest acpedia revision. Cross-checked acpedia's 'Towns' page and Category:Town for missing surface towns. Verified every site in WorldBuilder.Terminal: describe-landblock on the 3x3 around each town (534 LBs), get-height on every gazetteer teleloc, and clearance checks (query-radius 14 m) on new telelocs. FX positions are ACE world-DB outdoor spawns (cell < 0x100) from describe-landblock.
sources: acpedia 2021-06 dump (Towns, Category:Town and per-town pages, newest revision)

tiers.hero: multiple shots; JEV-eligible hero moves (Rithwic under-bridge, Lytelthorpe showcase, Holtburg opening, Sanamar Royal Hall, Linvak Tukal finale)
tiers.core: 2-4 shots incl. a facade pan where streetPanCandidate
tiers.optional: 1 shot or cut if the recording is short

chapters.title: Aluvian Heartlands
chapters.light: morning: low warm sun raking across Holtburg's hill, river glints; build to the Rithwic bridge + Lytelthorpe keep double climax

chapters.title: The Northern Frontier
chapters.light: late morning: crisp high-latitude light on castles and mountain towns

chapters.title: New Viamont & the Halaetan Isles
chapters.light: late morning to midday: bright sun on ice, surf and the Royal Hall

chapters.title: Marae Lassel
chapters.light: noon: swamps, spires and the Greenspire lighthouse under a high sun

chapters.title: West into the Dires
chapters.light: early afternoon: harsher light over plateaus, forts and the Obsidian Plains

chapters.title: The Gharu'ndim Realm
chapters.light: afternoon desert heat: oases, coves, domes; bonfire and fountain at Yaraq

chapters.title: The Sho Lands
chapters.light: late afternoon: long shadows across pagodas, rivers, bays and the shadow-ruined Tou-Tou lighthouse

chapters.title: Southern Isles & the Linvak Mountains
chapters.light: golden hour into a sunset finale (keep the sun above the horizon, about 0.80 to 0.84) on the snow fortress of Linvak Tukal

lookNotes.clouds: film CLI boots with ?clouds=on by default (tools/film/lib/session.mjs buildFilmUrl, owner 2026-10-14 'clouds have to be on'); never pass --clouds=off
lookNotes.timeOfDay: plan look.timeOfDay 0..1 (presets dawn 0.21, morning 0.33, noon 0.5, golden 0.82, dusk 0.89). The owner wants the sun out, so keep values in about 0.27..0.84, avoid night/dusk, and check sun elevation on the first still of each chapter. The chapters step morning, late morning, noon, afternoon, late afternoon, golden: one sunlit 'day' across Dereth
lookNotes.waterFlamesParticles: per-town visualHooks/fxSpawns list positions. Best flames: Sanamar bonfire, Yaraq bonfire (with fountain), the Tou-Tou Outpost flames cluster, forges at Zaikhal/Hebian-to/Baishi. Best water: Rithwic river and bridge, Holtburg river, Hebian-to river mouth, Mayoi bay, Kara lake, Yaraq cove, Greenspire/Ahurenga/Beach Fort/Eastwatch/Freehold/Kryst coasts. Fountains: Candeth Keep (3), Shoushi, Al-Jalima, Samsur, Ayan Baqur, Yaraq. Particle FX: every lifestone (sparkle column), Town Network and Tree/Ground portals (swirl), Plateau Village's 30 lanterns, Greenspire and Tou-Tou lighthouses

fieldNotes.core.droneMinZOverCore: max structure topZ anywhere in the 3x3 LBs + 5 m. Conservative: a hilltop tower can dominate it (Holtburg), so per-shot clearance still needs list-objects/query-radius at the actual camera line
fieldNotes.core.waterShare3x3: share of terrain vertices typed as water (sea/river/standing/slime) in the dominant-terrain lists of the 3x3; a coarse hint only
fieldNotes.fxSpawns: [worldX, worldY, z, weenieName] of outdoor ACE spawns (cell < 0x100): bonfire/flames/forge, fountain, lifestone, well. World metres: wx = lbX*192 + localX
fieldNotes.streetPanCandidate: >= 12 structures and >= 2 road LBs in the 3x3; still verify a 4 m clear corridor per shot
fieldNotes.teleport.best: telepoi = ACE POI drop (usually the Town Network portal drop); telelocs marked derived were built here from get-height + 14 m query-radius clearance

Piers 0x01000D72 at x38580 and 0x01000D71 at x38652, origin z 17.75; deck segments 0x01000D6F at x38604 and 0x01000D70 at x38628, origin z 20.95, bounds z -5..+6, so the underside is about z 16 and the top about z 27; deck width y 27055..27065. River channel x 38592..38640 at terrain/water z 4 (checked at y 27000..27120 along x 38616); banks rise to z 22 at x<=38568 and x>=38664. The under-deck gap is about 48 m wide by about 12 m tall. Fly the drone N-S along x 38612..38620 at z 8..10, which keeps about 4 m above the water and about 6 m below the deck. The river is the water shot; lifestone at 38726,27164 z22; 3 lanterns
